summary: Verification of nav-button-to-Link conversion across Home/Services/Staff/Faq plus SEO infra (sitemap, robots, NotFound, deep-link). ALL 9 test cases PASS. 9 Home + 5 Services + 2 Staff + 1 Faq converted elements render as <a> tags with correct href values and are clickable to navigate; visual styling unchanged (no layout regressions observed). CONTENT FREEZE verified — all spot-check CTA labels and headings present with identical casing on their respective pages ('Book an Introduction', 'Submit Intake Form', 'Book With Patrick', 'Meet The Team', 'Book Now' on Home; 'Book Now' on Services; 'Book With Patrick'/'Contact Us' on Staff; 'Book Your Free Introduction' belongs to Booking intake section and is present there). Deep link /booking#intake PASS (header bottom=108px, section's INTAKE FORMS heading top=186px — comfortably below sticky header, visually confirmed). /sitemap page renders (10 page/article links in main + footer-link-sitemap confirmed). GET /api/sitemap.xml returns valid XML with 11 <url> entries (8 pages + 3 blog posts), all on https://www.saskstartupsolutions.ca, exactly 3 <lastmod> values (blog posts), zero /admin /portal /api urls. /robots.txt served as text/plain with Disallow for /admin /portal /api/admin/ /api/auth/ plus Sitemap: https://www.saskstartupsolutions.ca/api/sitemap.xml and the full AI-crawler user-agent block. Unknown /zzz-nope renders not-found-page; /blog/nope renders post-not-found. Mobile 375px: documentElement.scrollWidth=375 (<=376 PASS), home-hero-book-btn visible/clickable, header-menu-btn + header-search-btn render. Per-route canonical: / and /services each have exactly 1 canonical with correct href on https://www.saskstartupsolutions.ca.

minor.issue: Response body is valid XML and backend sets media_type='application/xml', but the ingress/proxy returns Content-Type: application/json in headers. Body content is correct so search crawlers that sniff content will still parse it, but strict XML consumers may reject. Likely platform-layer rewrite; worth investigation.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why /api/sitemap.xml response Content-Type header is application/json at the preview edge despite backend setting application/xml — the body is correct so this is low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: Home featured-service-intake-btn testids are indexed i+1 (i.e. 1..5), not 0..4 as described in the review request — that's fine, all 5 exist and route to /booking#intake. Just worth keeping doc wording in sync.

Services service-book-btn testids use slug (bookkeeping/t2-corporate-filing/isc-registry/basic-package/introduction), not numeric index — same component is reused on Booking page which is why those 5 testids also appear on /booking. All 5 are <a href='/booking'>, correct.
Header account icon remains a <button> that opens /admin — intentionally left as button (auth gate, not crawler nav); confirmed and acceptable.

Deep-link /booking#intake relies on natural browser hash-scroll — intake section's heading lands at y=186 under an sticky header ending at y=108, so there's adequate clearance without needing scroll-margin-top. However, if header height grows, consider adding `scroll-margin-top: 120px` on the #intake section for defensive margin.
